name: Pricing effective dates resolution
what_it_tests: The Pricing Effective Dates step resolves the correct PricingDate from EffectiveDate/contract/line start date for proration and price lookup, so a future-dated line reads the future-effective pricebook
proc_mechanism: Pricing Effective Dates; Pricing Setting; Contacted Pricing (PricingDate seed); reads PBE as-of ServiceStartDate
expected_behavior: PricingDate correctly set; downstream proration/price-book uses the correct date (e.g. order 1/1, lines start 2/1 -> Feb pricebook)
test_setup: Line with EffectiveDate/ServiceStartDate set, contract-attached, future start
